annotation.bound_parties_text: The document is a government consultation and response that binds no one; it only states what the government will do and invites views.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: We’re seeking views on the opportunities for connected digital twins and other advanced cyber-physical systems to enable a national capability in CPI.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Connected systems of digital and physical, or ‘cyber-physical’, technologies such as digital twins and smart robotic systems, will be key to this.
